hogg.title: Introduction to Mathematical Statistics
hogg.authors: Robert V. Hogg, Joseph W. McKean and Allen T. Craig

probability-foundations.read: Chapters 1 and 2: Combinatorial Analysis; Axioms of Probability
probability-foundations.why: Sample spaces, the axioms, inclusion-exclusion and counting with and without replacement.

conditional-probability-and-bayes.why: Conditional probability, pairwise and mutual independence, total probability and Bayes' formula.

random-variables-and-distributions.read: Chapters 4 and 5: Random Variables; Continuous Random Variables
random-variables-and-distributions.why: Pmfs, pdfs, distribution functions, expectation and variance.

generating-functions.read: Chapter 1, Section 1.9: Some Special Expectations (moment generating functions)
generating-functions.why: MGFs, moments and uniqueness, as asked in every MAT 352 paper.

standard-distributions.why: Binomial, Poisson, gamma, exponential and normal distributions with their MGFs, means and variances.

joint-distributions-and-independence.why: Joint, marginal and conditional distributions, independence, correlation and transformations.

inequalities-and-limit-theorems.read: Chapter 1, Section 1.10 (Markov and Chebyshev) and Chapter 5: Consistency and Limiting Distributions
inequalities-and-limit-theorems.why: The inequalities, modes of convergence, the law of large numbers and the central limit theorem.
